name: Heavy Armor Master
description:
You can use your armor to deflect strikes that would kill others. You gain the following benefits:
- While wearing heavy armor, you reduce all damage except for psychic by your total Absorb value.
- Once per round, if you take damage below your total Absorb, you may use the Absorption feature without taking a Stress.
